title: The Buffa dissertation award
summary: Co-winner of the 2025 DSI Elwood S. Buffa Doctoral Dissertation Award.
body:
My dissertation, “Essays on Digital Technology-Enabled Mental Healthcare Delivery,” received the 2025 DSI Elwood S. Buffa Doctoral Dissertation Award. I shared the award with Hanu Tyagi.

I completed the dissertation at the University of Minnesota, advised by Kingshuk K. Sinha.
